## [2.4.0] - 2026-10-23
- x-mcp-header on a number parameter is rejected, as the 2026-07-28 spec requires
- outputSchema from z.object(...).meta({ id })
- The bundled Ajv validator uses fast-uri 3.1.8
- Skills over MCP
- Opt-in scope on token refresh
- ServerEvent takes optional params, so a gateway can forward change notifications with their _meta
- The v1 to v2 upgrade guide is also an installable agent skill
- update({ title }) on a resource or resource template shows up in list responses
- A Server connected to a per-request transport at a modern revision binds that revision instead of answering -32022
- createMcpHandler sends Allow
- @modelcontextprotocol/node accepts @hono/node-server 1.x or 2.x

## [2.3.0] - 2026-10-02
- One server per request
- Redirects stay on the same origin
- New options, both off unless you set them
- prompts/get without arguments is validated as {}, as tools/call already is
- The client requires eventsource-parser 3.0.8 or later
- validateOriginHeader and the allowedOrigins option of the Express, Fastify and Hono app helpers accept <scheme>://* entries such as moz-extension://*, so a serv
- tasks/get and tasks/cancel of the Tasks extension can be served and called on a 2026-07-28 connection
- A large message received as a single SSE event over Streamable HTTP is fast again
- prompts/get without arguments no longer fails when every argument of the prompt is optional
- SSEClientTransport refreshes once after a 401 on connect instead of retrying without limit
- registerTool no longer converts tool schemas up front, so a server built per request stops converting every tool on every request
- hono is a regular dependency of @modelcontextprotocol/node, so installs with strict peer-dependency checking no longer fail
- A server/discover probe answered with an unusable 2xx reply now says so instead of reading like a network failure
- McpServer.registerPrompt() types the callback correctly when no argsSchema is given
- The license field of the package manifests is Apache-2.0

## [2.2.0] - 2026-09-28
- Pass expectedIssuer to the machine-to-machine OAuth providers
- fetchToken() checks which authorization server the client information belongs to
- List calls return the whole list
- CommonJS TypeScript projects type-check again
- Client.listen() no longer lets a rejection escape as a process-level unhandled rejection, and no longer hangs when a send never settles
- _meta is preserved on input_required results
- Hostnames ending in .localhost count as loopback for OAuth token endpoints, so host-based multi-tenant local setups work
- OAuthTokensSchema and OAuthClientInformationSchema accept the optional issuer field, so a provider that reads its storage back through them keeps it
- createMcpHandler no longer overflows the stack when the factory returns the same server instance for more than one request
- createMcpHandler ends a subscriptions/listen stream right after the acknowledgement when it honored none of the requested notification types
- Sending a notification on a closed connection no longer produces a briefly unhandled promise rejection
- The v1-to-v2 codemod keeps a file's leading comment block and directives above the rewritten imports
- Corrected citations in the JSDoc for OAuth token endpoints and for the registerClient deprecation notice
